When I ordered they said will be there in 20 minutes thought they were kidding cause even dominos takes almost 30 minutes.
But sure enough in 20 minutes they were delivering and the pizza was like hot right out of oven .
The pizza is very authentic Italian style using high quality ingredients and is cooked in a wood fire oven .
There was a promotion that day buy a pizza get a margarita pizza free so with already reasonable prices the value was incredible 
Overall incredible fast friendly service ,incredible taste ,incredible value .
I have eaten many of the top pizzas in Saigon and we are lucky to have so many great pizza restaurants I consider REALE right up there with the best

Great Surprise at Pizza Reale
Mar 2020
First visit to Pizza Reale with a friend and we had such a pleasant surprise. The staff were very welcoming and attentive and overall the food was delightful. The wine was pleasant enough. We shared both a pizza and a pasta dish. The pizza was exceptionally nice, with a tasty tomato and cheese base, capers, black olives , hame and we asked if we could change the mushrooms for pineapple which they agreed to straightaway. The french fries were tasty and piping hot, as was the pizza. The pasts dish arrived soon after but was luke warm. When it was returned somewhat warmer the taste could be appreciated a lot more. The meatballs were so well cooked and melt in your mouth, the rigatoni to the right al dente and the tomato sauce was also very good. The food was served with a generous portion of Parmesan cheese as a side dish and the home made tartar sauce that accompanied the french fries was lovely. My friend had the Tiramisu for desert and said it was beautiful. I has the Dolce Vita vanilla ice cream which had a standard vanilla flavour, with a tasty espresso to pour over it. It was very quiet there but it was very early evening so next time we will go a lot later. But a very pleasant find indeed and very close to our homes.
